stem: A work surface is sprayed with disinfectant and wiped dry immediately even though the procedure specifies a longer wet contact period. What is the strongest concern?
choices: The surface may look too shiny
The disinfectant may not receive the required contact time to perform as intended
The surface can never be used again
rationale: Disinfectants depend on approved concentration and contact conditions. Shortening the specified contact period can reduce effectiveness.
